question: Choose the synonym of the word 'Bawdy'.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Coarse**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Bawdy"** refers to something that is humorously indecent, obscene, or vulgar in nature. (अश्लील, फूहड़)

 
 
• **Example:** The comedian's bawdy jokes often left the audience either laughing or blushing.
 
 
 
• **"Coarse"** means rough or crude in manner, language, or behavior. It can also imply a lack of refinement. (अशिष्ट, भद्दा)
 
 
• **Example:** His coarse language offended many people at the formal gathering.
 
 
 
• As both "Bawdy" and "Coarse" share a similar connotation of being vulgar or crude, they can be considered synonyms.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Coarse**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Support** (समर्थन): To bear all or part of the weight of something; to hold up or assist.

 
 
• **Example:** She always provides emotional support to her friends during difficult times.
 
 
 
• **Delay** (विलंब): To make someone or something late or slow down the progress.
 
 
• **Example:** The heavy traffic caused a delay in reaching the airport.
 
 
 
• **Establish** (स्थापित करना): To set up or create something on a firm or permanent basis.
 
 
• **Example:** The company plans to establish a new branch in the city.
